# tea_sachet — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture B, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.851.

Evidence: f3043, f3039, f3021. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/tea_sachet_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Rebuilt long tapered folded wrappers, photographed their visible reverse sides, and regenerated six float64 convex strips per packet. Refit all four packet instances; a third asset view remains too occluded for individual packet scoring.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.
- Corrected nearly edge-on UV visibility filtering and matte wrapper response, then baked the observed orange/brown paper surfaces.

Remaining:
- Four partly hidden packets have only two reliable individual masks; the third asset view does not resolve every packet boundary.
- Tentative constitutive parameters and rigid proxy; no validated deformation solver or grasp sequence.
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.
